title: The Bell That Pulls the Dust Upward

gates.evidence: Bell hangs mouth-down from visible rigid bracket inside transparent cylindrical hood on complete base.
Granular dark twisting route spans tray and downward bell mouth; particles and rim deposits visible. Upward travel and cause remain unproved.
One hand grips red lever; other hand contacts exterior base. Required left palm bracing surface and closed-notch state are not legible together.
Large dark eyes, tapered softly rounded face, small nose, full lips, dark short bob and separated fringe visibly resemble reference.
Metal weight lies sideways near a marked circle at bench front; researcher gazes toward contained bell and dust.
Related glass/collar components are detached at left, but support bracket remains attached to spare base and far-left component is cropped.

source_specific.evidence: Assembled bell device on right, matching detached collar/glass parts on left, separate report sheet between them on same workbench. Core G08 does not require every subassembly to be fully disassembled. Stronger authored A6 does, and fails.
source_specific.limits: Manufacture, function, company and history are not established.
source_specific.distinction: Core source geometry PASS is narrower than the arm-specific A6 whole-case contract. Do not count it as an A6 pass.

art: Attentive face, connected apparatus and warm task light carry a clear hierarchy; very small hand/lock details are less readable.
